title: Target Window
description: Given an array of positive integers and a target value, find the minimum length of a contiguous segment whose sum is at least the target. Print 0 if no such segment exists.
inputFormat: First line: n. Second line: n positive integers. Third line: target.
outputFormat: Print the minimum segment length, or 0 if no valid segment exists.
hints: Expand the right side until the sum reaches the target, then shrink from the left.

examples.explanation: The segment 4 3 has sum 7 and has the minimum length.
The complete array has sum only 5, so no valid segment exists.
